drawn.verdict: REBOUND 5.2.1 IAS15 with the star, Sable, Kakakiko, both moons, and Croquet Ball kept the 2:1 locked for the 20,000 years that were run. A second run of the same bodies lasted 1,200 years. Those lengths are the runs, not a lifetime.

moons.lagrange: Neither moon's L4 or L5 is a station. The 2026-10-09 run lost the equilateral particles and both L3 controls inside 50 years.

synchronous: A test particle at 54,076 km was quiet for 1,000 years. v2.41c did not repeat that particle.
giants: The older giant check is not the moon verdict.
croquet_trojans: A v2.40 REBOUND run of 100,000 years kept test particles at Croquet Ball's L4 and L5 on tadpole orbits. The jumpgate may sit at L4 or L5. Which one is still open.
